# HRnet

> HRnet is an employee management tool for HR teams: create employee records and browse the current roster by name, department, and location.

HRnet is a single-page React application. Employee records are saved to the browser's localStorage and never sent to a server, so no employee data is reachable by crawlers.

## Pages

- [Create Employee](https://hrnet-p14-six.vercel.app/): Form for adding an employee, including name, dates, department, and address.
- [Employee List](https://hrnet-p14-six.vercel.app/employee-list): Table of every employee saved in the current browser.
